notes.title: Luster Beasts 2.0
notes.content:
The 2.0 patch for Luster Beasts has been released to aid in the kickstarter which will launch on Monday. We updated both the base game and the demo to include all content currently available in the game, but going forward, the demo will not receive any of the game's updates other than occassional balance and bug fixes. Any content updates will be exclusive to the paid for version of the game. Below is the link to the Kickstarter if you would like to support it.

Kickstarter Link: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1984929156/luster-beasts

notes.title: 1.0 Released
notes.content: Hello everyone. Today we finally release Luster Beasts to Steam. From the entire development team, we hope you love the game we have spent so much time working on.

notes.title: Patch .90
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Added a volume slider
[*] Luster Beasts now display their type, weakness and strength
[*] Allows the player to pull up the menu without the game quitting
[*] Fixed the bug where status effects would cause the game to crash
[/list]
